```plato
//==
// # Numbers

// Sections, in order:
//  - Extended-number arithmetic

//  - Modified Bessel functions I0 and I1
//  - Beta and regularized incomplete beta
//  - Error function and complement

library Numbers
{
    //==
    // # Extended-number arithmetic
    //
    // Operator and interface obligations for the types of `numbers.types.plato`: Complex
    // (full INumerical plus ComplexÃ—Complex product/quotient), Rational (IComparable
    // plus field arithmetic), and the unitless constrained scalars Proportion /
    // Percent / Probability (INumerical + IComparable on their carrier).

    //==
    // Complex â€” INumerical obligations and complex field arithmetic.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Complex_number

    // Component-wise sum.
    Add(a: Complex, b: Complex): Complex
        => (a.Real + b.Real, a.Imaginary + b.Imaginary);
```

## Line 83

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/numbers.library.plato, line 83](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/numbers.library.plato#L83).

```plato

    //==
    // Rational â€” exact ratio arithmetic and order.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rational_number
    // Results are not reduced; callers that need a canonical form should
    // divide out the GCD separately when that helper exists.

    // a/b + c/d = (ad + bc) / (bd). Precondition: neither denominator is zero.
    Add(a: Rational, b: Rational): Rational
        => new Rational(
            a.Numerator * b.Denominator + b.Numerator * a.Denominator,
            a.Denominator * b.Denominator);
```

```plato
    //==
    // # IAdditive obligations
    //
    // Differentiation is linear, so sums and differences are component-wise.

    // (a + b)' = a' + b'.
    Add(a: DualNumber, b: DualNumber): DualNumber
        => (a.Value + b.Value, a.Derivative + b.Derivative);
```
